player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's merlin role was expertly played, using his knowledge to influence the team's decisions and keep our objectives a secret until the end.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: As the Assassin, I could have improved by paying closer attention to my intuition about team alignments and using my Eliminate skill more strategically to disrupt the good team's chances. player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's Merlin role was expertly played - I have no insight into his decision-making or strategy, but it is clear that he effectively contributed to the good team's successes without revealing his identity.
